long_biography.plain_text:
For arts patron Olimpia Torlonia Weiller, a palace fire became the starting point for a new commission. She told Atelier dell'Errore's artists about finding melted gold from ceiling decorations among the ashes. Their response was a permanent frieze of fantastical animals in gold leaf at Palazzo Nunez-Torlonia, commissioned by her and completed in 2024.

She also initiated Donne-toi des ailes with the Aero-club Paul-Louis Weiller, providing most of its funding for a decade. The programme introduced students with lower-limb disabilities to flying in aircraft fitted with hand controls. Participants could work towards pilot qualifications or continue flying with an instructor when medical approval for solo flight was unavailable.
